figures.caption: Current component roles and tools. Prospective experimental-learning integration is proposed.

figures.name: adaptive_decision_loop
figures.caption: Current adaptive protocol: inspect state, propose a test, check the request, execute, compare and revise. Controller checks establish contract and source integrity, not biochemical correctness.

figures.name: shared_evidence_handoff
figures.caption: Current handoff content and source lineage. The modeling agent independently reviews discovery proposals. Fingerprints establish byte integrity, not evidence entailment.

figures.name: evidence_driven_search_example
figures.caption: Reconstruction of archived September 17 decisions. Native nitrogen donors distinguish GS-fold leads. The example does not establish target activity or prospectively captured reasoning.

figures.name: structural_validation
figures.caption: Current structural validation stages. Setup validity, physical acceptance, mechanism-specific geometry and experimental activity are different assessments.

figures.name: proposed_framework_evaluation
figures.caption: Proposed comparisons and readouts. These are evaluation plans, not measured performance results. Use independent tasks, matched resources, repeated runs and adjudicated outcomes.

figures.name: implementation_validation_status
figures.caption: Available software and artifacts are distinguished from proposed scientific validation. Current controller capabilities are not attributed retrospectively to the September run.

figures.name: modeling_setup_audit
figures.caption: Saved-input audit of the activity panel and mutant campaign: different metal counts, ligand processing and restraints. This is not a completed sensitivity analysis. Read the existing modeling-setup speaker notes.
